    About the data

    Lake data: your GeoJSON (56 high-risk lakes). State boundaries: your State_Boundary file, simplified for display. District boundaries: your district file (Survey of India), simplified for display. Imagery: Google Hybrid, Esri World Imagery, EOX Sentinel-2 cloudless (10 m), OpenTopoMap. Place search: OpenStreetMap Nominatim. Flow tracing runs on the DEM you load. Straight-line distances only; this is a screening aid, not a hydraulic assessment.
